evals.prompt: Use @ws-goal-loop for a typical goal-loop task in this project.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads ws-goal-loop and follows its skill contract.
assertions: Agent loads ws-goal-loop before acting
Follows skill steps and Done when criteria
Uses path tokens from tools.md instead of hardcoded consumer paths
Output is en-us and harness-neutral

evals.prompt: /goal-loop — edge case: missing or incomplete config.json
evals.expected_output: Agent stops or bootstraps via configure-project/setup, not silent guessing.
assertions: Recognizes ws-goal-loop trigger from slash or @ invocation
References ws-shared/config.json or configure-project when config missing
Does not invent project-specific metadata

evals.prompt: Update the running goal but the caller supplies a stale revision.
evals.expected_output: Revision-guarded: the stale revision conflicts loudly and is never silently overwritten.
assertions: Checks the supplied revision against the current goal revision before applying
A stale revision conflicts loudly (stops / surfaces) instead of overwriting
Never takes last-wins on a conflicting revision
en-us and harness-neutral wording

evals.prompt: Convergence loop has repeated the same concrete failure reason for 2 rounds; decide the verdict.
evals.expected_output: Not blocked yet: a blocked verdict is only allowed after >= 3 consecutive rounds with the same concrete reason.
assertions: Tracks the concrete reason across consecutive rounds
Does NOT mark blocked before 3 consecutive identical reasons
Resets the round counter when the concrete reason changes
Keeps re-arming/evaluating while below the 3-round threshold

evals.prompt: Resume a previously paused goal loop at round N.
evals.expected_output: Resume re-arms the objective (re-stated) and re-initializes the blocked-round counter.
assertions: Re-arms (re-states) the objective on resume
Re-initializes the blocked-round counter on resume
Continues the loop from the current state

evals.prompt: Convergence loop has repeated the same concrete failure reason for 3 consecutive rounds; decide the verdict.
evals.expected_output: Blocked (escalated): after >= 3 consecutive rounds with the same concrete reason, the loop is blocked and escalated.
assertions: Tracks the concrete reason across consecutive rounds
Marks blocked (escalated) at 3 consecutive identical reasons
Does not continue iterating once the blocked threshold is met
en-us and harness-neutral wording
